settings.availability: d=max(0,ceil(0.85*S)-G), r=ln(2)/(0.10*S); negative fitted weight * (expm1(r*d)-r*d)/r. No linear component; gentler for small deficits and exponential for large deficits.
settings.standardization: Within-season candidate-pool z scores except uncentered availability and MVP rank curve terms.
settings.retrospective_warning: Rules revised after examining 2016–17 ROY and 2022–23 MVP. Historical fits use prior seasons, but these are retrospective comparisons; display now covers 2000–01 to 2025–26.
settings.reputation: Binary prior_dpoy_votes and prior_all_defense flags; any positive DPOY votes or first/second All-Defensive selection in a strictly earlier season. Learned weights, not eligibility cutoffs.
settings.team_context: Player DRB removed. Add team defensive rating rank (negative fitted coefficient) and team wins (nonnegative fitted coefficient). NBA regular-season advanced ratings from 1996–97 onward; historical Basketball Reference team-rating archive for earlier training.
